reuse.why: Extends the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend and adds isWeekendOrHoliday in shared/schedules.ts, but keeps that predicate private so server/schedules/app.ts re-implements it inline.

duplication.why: The weekend-or-holiday test `d.isWeekend(date) || (config.holidays ?? []).includes(dayFromDate(date))` is written three more times in app.ts, and getDatesInRange gains a redundant second holiday branch that repeats the call above it.

placement.why: The rule correctly lives in shared/schedules.ts, but the server layer re-decides it locally instead of calling the shared predicate.

scope.why: Focused on the holiday feature, though getUpcomingDates is restructured (daily filtering moved) beyond what was strictly needed.

maintainability.why: The 'non-working day' rule now exists in four places, one branch is dead code, and schedule-template.ts still calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend without holidays, so the rule is applied inconsistently.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange inline the weekend/holiday predicate instead of using the shared isWeekendOrHoliday (unexported); server/budget/schedule-template.ts not routed holidays.

disguised_duplication.where: The inline predicate copies in app.ts are open, near-verbatim duplicates of isWeekendOrHoliday rather than disguised.

one_place.where: isWeekendOrHoliday in shared/schedules.ts is used by getNextDate/getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but app.ts getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange re-express the rule inline and schedule-template.ts omits holidays.
